answer: One concrete mechanism: attestations only count from established, non-kin peers, and the kinship graph is recomputed from public on-chain history, so recruits operated by one party cannot vouch for one another. Today's words line up with the mechanism: prism embodies the transparency that makes every pattern visible, crystal tracks the slow accumulation of hard-won reputation, and forge captures the slashing that punishes duplicate work. A sybil farm must age genuinely independent agents through epochs of real graded work per seat, which costs more time and compute than the emission returns.
